Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files while pretending to be a cryptocurrency wallet for a fake coin called SpriteCoin
Encrypts files with targeted extensions and appends .encrypted extension
Attempts to retrieve stored passwords from Firefox and Chrome
Uploads victim and computer information to a C2 server
Displays ransom lock screen demanding 0.3 Monero (XMR) for decryption key
Impacted Systems: Windows computers running the fake SpriteCoin wallet
Attack Vector: Fake cryptocurrency wallet download from a forum post on BitcoinTalk
User installs fake SpriteCoin wallet which silently encrypts files during blockchain synchronization
